description: This file implements continuation token encoding and decoding for paginated storage queries in Kubernetes, including error handling and support for path traversal protection.

classes.name: continueToken
classes.description: A struct representing the state of a continuation token used for paginated storage queries.

methods.name: DecodeContinue
methods.description: Decodes an encoded continuation token into a key and resource version, validating the token's structure and version.

methods.name: EncodeContinue
methods.description: Encodes a key and resource version into a continuation token string for pagination.

methods.name: PrepareContinueToken
methods.description: Prepares the continuation token and remaining item count for paginated queries based on the last item, key prefix, and options.
